identity.distinct_from: DoubleML R implementation and other orthogonal-learning engines

license.observed: BSD3-Clause; retained notices,disclaimer and nonendorsement conditions in original

target: Selected IRM ATE on a declared identified binary-action adjustment law; other score and panel families require separate profiles.
uncertainty: Asymptotic independent-unit score uncertainty under identification,overlap,nuisance-rate and sampling assumptions; no arbitrary temporal or cluster guarantee.
proposed_route: Retain Python DoubleML as a transparent score/inference reference and candidate adapter; defer integration_allowed until complete distribution,dependencies and adverse behavior are qualified.
conversion_contract: Require exactly one binary0/1 treatment for IRM and explicitly name pre-action adjustment columns; never admit every remaining column by default.
Preserve row identity across outcomes,treatments,external nuisance predictions and supplied folds; reject mismatched shapes,keys or training/evaluation provenance.
Record score=ATE versus ATTE,weights,IPW normalization and propensity processing; clipping is a numerical policy,not proof of overlap.
Return estimate units,sampling law,variance convention,warnings and unsupported uncertainty separately; refuse an arbitrary dependent-series request under the iid profile.
Treat DoubleMLPanelData first-treatment timing and static_panel choice as a separate target contract; it is not an arbitrary trajectory container.
Keep identified causal premise separate from backend score computation; do not treat numerical agreement as causal truth.
alternatives: A transparent independent score implementation for the same fixed-profile oracle.
Separately qualified EconML or R DoubleML profiles under matched targets and sampling assumptions.
No estimator when identification or useful uncertainty is unsupported.

required: Version migration and deprecated propensity API handling
Rights inventory and ongoing conformance review

owner_obligations: Scientific reviewer selects target,controls,sampling law and uncertainty conditions.
Maintainer preserves row identity,folds,warning/refusal semantics and exact package artifacts.
Authorized product owner reviews applicable deployment and distribution conditions before integration.
revisit_trigger: Obtain a complete hash-pinned release and dependency lock with original license inventory; execute adverse conversion,missingness,overlap,fold,weight and sampling tests before enabling a narrowly declared adapter.
limitations: Selected installed0.11.4 excerpts and two commit-pinned API files are distinct provenance objects; complete wheel/lock provenance remains open.
Observed BSD3-Clause text is bound; a complete transitive dependency/redistribution audit has not been performed.
No new package install, external model, native benchmark, coverage study or bank acceptance.
Prior runtime matching is retained only for its explicit fixed-fold/external-prediction IRM profile.
Maintenance metadata is a dated observation, not a support guarantee.
